notes: Snapshot carried over from the original single-file app (index.html, commit 76d2705). Eligibility rows reflect the FDEP PRP Eligibility Report run 09/05/2026; DERM-derived files (ut-mapping, folios, facid-tasks) come from DERM exports and are not rebuilt by scripts/refresh_data.py.

facilities.json.source: FDEP STCM Contaminated Facility List (Miami-Dade, County 13)

eligibility.json.source: FDEP STCM PRP Eligibility Report / All Open Discharges (Miami-Dade)

shared-address.json.source: FDEP DEP Cleanup Sites (County 13, shared ADDRESS1+ZIP5)

ut-mapping.json.source: EXTERNAL: Miami-Dade DERM export (UT work group -> FACID)

folios.json.source: EXTERNAL: Miami-Dade DERM export (DERMPermit_gdb folios by work group)

facid-tasks.json.source: EXTERNAL: Miami-Dade DERM export (Contaminated_Site.csv task names)

icr.json.source: FDEP GIS DWM_WASTE_ICR_BACKG/12 (Florida Institutional Controls Registry), Miami-Dade
